reviewItem.question: For "fix: Only set discard logger if debug is false by @simonklb in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6274", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In Crossplane 2.0.0 the discard logger is only set when debug is false, so with debug enabled the discard logger is no longer installed and debug-mode log output that was previously discarded is now emitted.
